title: Travelpro® Crew™ VersaPack™ Global Carry-on Expandable Spinner
transcript: [Video Description/Summary]: Go anywhere with a spinner that is all your own. The Crew™ VersaPack™ Global Carry-on Expandable Spinner is designed for total packing versatility and customizable with a variety of interchangeable Travelpro® exclusive Zip-In Organizers. Included inside the lid is a removable Zip-In Garment Organizer, ideal for storing folded shirts ...
